description: This file defines the 'SeoMetaPartHandler' class, a content part handler for SEO metadata in OrchardCore CMS. It manages SEO-related aspects such as page titles, meta descriptions, OpenGraph, Twitter cards, and canonical URLs, integrating with OrchardCore services and media storage.

classes.name: SeoMetaPartHandler
classes.description: A content part handler for managing SEO metadata, including OpenGraph and Twitter card data, within OrchardCore CMS.

methods.name: SeoMetaPartHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for SEO metadata handling.

methods.name: GetContentItemAspectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously populates the SEO aspect with data from the SeoMetaPart, including URLs, images, and social media tags.
